format: all affine input/output signed32 Q16.16, homogeneous column vectors
input_direction: previous accepted camera frame to current
determinant_threshold: unsigned64 rawQ32, abs(Tdet) and abs(Sdet) strictly greater
round: nearest ties away for products; inverse linear division toward zero
overflow: explicit rejection, all12 output fields zero, T/S rollback
scene_cut: highest priority rebase identity, input transform ignored
reference_after_rejection: align next motion to last accepted frame or explicit scene cut
reset: synchronous active low overrides CE, T=S=identity
